nonentry_missing_mirrors.description: Watch countertrend technical SHORT correction against verified D1/H4 uptrend; mirror of B7 but not short-entry

phases.R0: Confirmed D1/H4 UPTREND with causal HH/HL; potential countertrend downward relief only; not a trend-reversal verdict.
phases.R_C: Price extension vs as-of ATR and/or known H1/H4 resistance; deterministic predeclared level and spread quality still PENDING.
phases.R_E: CLOSED M15 rejection/CHoCH_DOWN with event ID, own first-known and retrieved times; research/watch only.
phases.R_F: No trade by default; any later review requires separate owner numerical approval, OOS and countertrend risk policy; no short-entry promotion.

nonentry_missing_mirrors.description: Watch trough of downswing at known target/support and protect/exit an actual verified SHORT; never independent BUY

phases.R0: H1/H4 downtrend, preknown target/support and verified OPEN_SHORT position required to issue exit advice; otherwise WATCH_ONLY.
phases.R_C: Approach approved TP/support with as-of ADR/exhaustion or risk invalidation check; no hindsight or price-side confusion.
phases.R_E: CLOSED M15 causal CHoCH_UP or source-verified approved TP trigger; no unsourced fill assertion.
phases.R_F: CLOSED H1/M15 break above known minor lower-high/micro-resistance or independently approved actual TP fill event; can only warn/exit verified SHORT, never enter LONG.

nonentry_missing_mirrors.description: Watch downside capitulation/exhaustion and protect/exit SHORT; analogous to S8 upside blow-off but not independent BUY

phases.R0: Downside D1/H4 price acceleration vs historical as-of return/ATR distribution; not an assertion of final major bottom.
phases.R_C: Measure causal lower wick/failed downside extension and exhaustion without volume-climax requirement, with prior known quote lineage.
phases.R_E: CLOSED M15 failed low/micro CHoCH_UP with first-known event timestamp; no future-confirmation leak.
phases.R_F: CLOSED H1/H4 micro-resistance recovery provides warning/exit SHORT only with verified position/rights and risk policy; never entry LONG.

cross_overlap_precedence: Existing original confirmed position protection (S3/S8 or proposed FX-B10/FX-B11) requires independently verified open position, cannot create opposite-side entry.
B7 and proposed FX-B11 can both arise after downside stretch: WATCH_ONLY and EXIT_SHORT warning are different roles, no duplicate trade.
S8 and proposed FX-S11 can both arise after upside stretch: EXIT_LONG warning and WATCH_ONLY are different roles, no duplicate trade.
S3/S8 or FX-B10/FX-B11 share a position/event risk ledger: never count two exits for one underlying verified position event.
Every same instrument/calendar/known-origin event must have one research opportunity identity independent of zone label; unknown origin -> NO_SIGNAL.
Never infer side-mirror threshold, fees, swap, slippage, gain, verified TP/SL or untreated chronological OOS from qualitative symmetry.
